prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile app concept comp, portrait phone screen
Primary request: Create a polished native mobile UI mockup for the ACNH Diary mobile control system, screen 2 of 3: Villagers and resident status controls. This is an iOS-first React Native app that must later adapt to Android. Korean-speaking Animal Crossing player audience. Structure: native safe-area header with title 주민 and island selector, search row, compact icon category rail, two-column villager card grid. Each villager card uses a large round villager portrait thumbnail, Korean name, tiny species/personality chips, and a row of large 48dp status icon buttons: wishlist heart, island resident house, moved-out arrow, campsite tent, photo frame. Selected states use filled color + icon + subtle check, not color alone. Reduce long explanatory text; keep only short Korean labels like 전체, 위시, 우리 섬, 캠핑, 액자. Show a bottom sheet partially open for one selected villager with bigger status toggles and accessible-looking labels. Visual world: NookPhone-inspired original control layer, warm island paper background, leaf green primary, resident coral, catalog amber, museum blue, neutral dark ink, soft tactile buttons, crisp hierarchy. Use cute official-game-like villager portrait icons/ACNH-inspired imagery if helpful, but no Nintendo logo and no copied app chrome. High-fidelity phone screenshot, 390x844 logical portrait, no web chrome, no watermark.
